data.title: 卡提希娅 · 铁匠铺的保养
data.description: 铁匠铺，她把迅刀交给师傅保养，趴在柜台边看锻打的火花；聊起剑的手感时眼睛发亮——比起圣女，她更习惯骑士的身份。
data.action: 铁匠铺，她把迅刀交给师傅保养，趴在柜台边看锻打的火花
data.promptProse: At the smithy counter, Cartethyia has laid her sheathed sword on a padded cloth for maintenance. She rests her forearms on the counter and watches sparks rise from the distant forge where the smith works beyond the edge of the frame, blue eyes brightening as she talks about the feel of her blade. Her cream high-collared tunic, blue travel jacket and practical trousers retain the unassuming appearance of a wandering knight. Warm forge light reaches her blonde braid and the counter; the sparks stay around the far anvil, beyond her reach.
